title: Which design shows causation?
statement:
Which study can best show that a new fertilizer **causes** higher crop yields?

[_]{a}

choices: Randomly assign 100 plots to fertilizer or no fertilizer, then treat them the same otherwise
Compare farms that chose to use it with farms that didn't
Use it on the best plots and compare with the rest
explanations: Self-selection: better farms may choose it.

solution: Random assignment plus identical treatment otherwise: a randomized controlled experiment.
